name: Hetalia: Lonely World
source:
As Antarctica, You've, historically been left to fend for yourself. Up until recently that is, where you've become a bit of a hot topic, as a place completely unexplored. Several places from the around the world have begun vying for your attention, and worryingly so its hard to tell if its because they actually care about the South pole itself, or are just dropping by because everyone else seems to be.

This game does not take place during a specific period in time, however, many interactions reference history in relation to the exploration, and claims over Antarctica.

[from [url=https://hallow-ghost.itch.io/hetalia-lonely-world]itch.io[/url]]
